patterns.name: Global TPA Integration Framework
patterns.description: Lookup after initial application page; resolve membership/coverage status; execute client-configured decision path.

patterns.name: TPA Coverage-Based Verification
patterns.description: Standard / AMA: lookup First Name, Last Name and DOB. ASCE additionally requires Membership ID. Existing member + active coverage runs LexisNexis; pass enables portfolio and auto-approval; fail/skipped falls back to TPA admin manual review without portfolio.

patterns.name: TPA Membership-Based Auto Approval
patterns.description: WAEPA variation: lookup First Name, Last Name and DOB. New member auto-approves; existing member goes to TPA admin manual review regardless of coverage status. Neither branch runs LexisNexis or displays a portfolio.

patterns.name: Disability Income Replacement Formula
patterns.description: Maximum Benefit = MIN(Monthly Income × Replacement %, Policy Cap), with age/plan/class exceptions, tiered percentages, fixed increments, existing-coverage offsets, and fixed/age-based exceptions.

patterns.name: Coverage Amount Option Families
patterns.description: Covers fixed, set/list, range+increment, tiered ranges, range+fixed, conditional, calculated, named/code, N/A, attribute-mapped, formula-capped, base-reference, multiplier, election-only and unspecified-increment patterns.

flagDefinitions.name: Site offers QD
flagDefinitions.derivation: True when at least one enabled product supports QD.

flagDefinitions.name: Applicant applying for QD
flagDefinitions.derivation: True when selected product/path is QD for applicant.

flagDefinitions.name: Product has QD
flagDefinitions.derivation: Depends on configured QD pathway and current applicant selections/amount bands.

flagDefinitions.name: Application has underwritten coverage
flagDefinitions.derivation: True for selected member/spouse Life, Disability or Office Overhead; false for child-only Life or only AD&D/HI.
